options.title: Start with the context you already have
options.intro: No form or account is required. Send a short message now, then add detail as the conversation develops.

whatsApp.label: Primary contact
whatsApp.title: Message VANTFLOW on WhatsApp
whatsApp.body: Use the prepared introduction, then add your website and the SEO question you want to discuss.

email.label: Email fallback
email.title: Send a longer note by email
email.body: Email works well when you need to include detailed context or links.

replyNote: VANTFLOW aims to reply within two business days. Timing can vary with the detail needed to review your request.

prepare.title: A few details make the first reply more useful
prepare.body: You do not need a finished brief. If available, include:
items: Your website or the page involved
The search or business problem you have noticed
Any deadline, platform, market, or implementation constraint

cta.title: Prefer a scoped review? Start with the audit
